description.value: Beach House Restaurant occupies a heritage-designated 1912 building in West Vancouver's Dundarave neighbourhood, overlooking Burrard Inlet with an oceanview patio now open for summer. The seafood-centric menu blends West Coast ingredients with Southern California influences, featuring a sushi and raw bar, rotating seasonal dishes, and an extensive martini and wine list. The second-floor Landing event space offers unobstructed water views, and the building has served the waterfront community continuously — under various names — for over a century.
